_doc: Sport discovery (#21, scripts/discover.mjs <sport> <region>). For a sport and a region it finds venues in OpenStreetMap (and Google Places when GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY is set, place ids only), works out where each publishes its schedule from its website (config/platforms.json), and proposes the new venues as one pull request per sport. `ignore` lists OSM ids or names to never propose again.
